address: Avenida de la Albufereta 13, Alacant, 03016, Spain
bio: If you’re looking for something truly out of the ordinary, this restaurant in Alicante is definitely the place to head for, but make sure you book ahead. In this unique space, the dining experience is akin to a game that moves from one space to the next (Black Tech, Hi Line, Cocoon Lab and Geoda Verde), each of which features highly personalised decor and provides a backdrop of different visual effects and even specific aromas for your fine-dining experience. Chef Pablo Montoro’s fun and entertaining cuisine, including creative, travel-inspired dishes that showcase the Mediterranean, is focused around three tasting menus: Espacio, Experiencia and Sentidos.
